milestones.title: Continue the monthly Kaunter Aduan Rakyat in Setiu
milestones.description: Shaharizukirnain described a recurring public-complaints counter that lets residents raise local problems directly.
milestones.progress_note: The dated session at Kampung Bukit Kecil is documented. Holding a counter is not proof that all road, land or welfare complaints were resolved. Later sessions and an overall completion measure were not verified.
